summary.name: Hue in the Menu
summary.one_liner: A free macOS menu bar app for controlling Philips Hue lights in one click, including turning off all lights or scheduling a shutdown.
use_cases: Turn off all Hue lights in the house from the Mac menu bar
Schedule lights to switch off after a few minutes or an hour
Control Philips Hue lights without opening the Hue app
Assign keyboard shortcuts to global light actions
Manage multi-room Hue lighting from a Mac
summary.what_it_does: The app puts Philips Hue light management in the macOS system menu bar, allowing lights to be controlled in one click. It supports the Hue Bridge Pro and lets users assign keyboard shortcuts to certain global light actions. Users can turn off the entire house at once or schedule a shutdown in a few minutes or an hour. The page describes it as simple and minimal, and it is listed as a menu bar tool in the awesome-mac list.
notable: Entirely free with no subscriptions or upgrades, though it has in-app purchases for optional tips
Supports the new Hue Bridge Pro
Keyboard shortcuts for global light actions
Received a new app icon designed and donated by Josh Miller
caveats: Mac only; requires macOS 12.4 or later
Contains in-app purchases (optional developer coffee and lamp financing tips)
Not enough ratings or reviews to display an overview
